武判官不再理会她的嘶吼，转头看向吴姜，语气缓和了几分：“小友，本官就将她先带回去了，等到审判之后，自会押解回地府接受处罚，至于你的奖励，等到审判结束，自会下发。”

顿了顿，武判官又补充道：“对了，你可以在这别墅里找找。这女鬼能多次隐藏气息，躲避我们的搜寻，想必是有一件遮蔽气息的法器，那法器应该就在她藏身的地方，算是你的战利品，你可自行取走。”

吴姜眼睛一亮，连忙对着武判官拱手道谢：“多谢判官大人！”

判官点了点头，一挥手，四个阴差押解着女鬼，消失不见。

就在这时，一股熟悉的温热气流，突然从体内涌现出来，顺着经脉缓缓游走，比之前完成任务后的暖流，更加浓郁，浑身都暖洋洋的，疲惫感瞬间消散得干干净净，体内的魂力，也瞬间充盈起来。

“咦，这也有奖励吗？还来的这么快？”吴姜心中一喜。

等到武判官等人彻底消失，吴姜没有急着在别墅里寻找那件法器，而是先拿出手机，给王老板打了个电话，告诉他们女鬼已经被收服，让他们可以回来了。

没过多久，王老板夫妇和老爷子就匆匆赶了回来，看到吴姜好好地站在院子里，还有一旁依旧昏睡的王寻，连忙围了上来。

“小姜，怎么样？女鬼……女鬼真的被收服了？”王老板急切地问道，眼神里满是期盼和忐忑，不敢相信这一切这么快就结束了。

吴姜笑着点了点头，语气轻松地说道：“王叔，放心吧，厉鬼已经被除了，事情彻底解决了。”

王老板大喜，上前紧紧的握住了吴姜的手，王夫人更是喜极而泣。

“先让人将王寻抬到楼上吧。”吴姜说道。

看着还在昏睡的王寻，众人将疑惑的目光看向了吴姜。

“不用担心，等王公子醒来多晒晒太阳，再开些补药吃吃就行了！”

王夫人连忙点了点头，对着吴姜连连道谢：“多谢小姜，多谢小姜！”

一旁的佣人见状，连忙上前，小心翼翼地将王寻抬上二楼的房间休息，王夫人也紧随其后，寸步不离地守着儿子。

Judge Wu ignored her screams and turned to look at Wu Jiang. His tone softened a bit: "Little friend, I will take her back first. After the trial, I will escort her back to the underworld to receive punishment. As for your reward, I will issue it after the trial is over."

After a pause, Judge Wu added: "By the way, you can look for it in this villa. This female ghost has been able to hide her aura many times and evade our search. She must have a magic weapon that masks her aura. That magic weapon should be where she is hiding. It is your trophy. You can take it away by yourself."

Wu Jiang's eyes lit up and he quickly thanked Judge Wu: "Thank you so much, Judge Wu!"

The judge nodded and waved his hand, and the four ghosts escorted the female ghost and disappeared.

At this moment, a familiar stream of warm air suddenly emerged from the body and slowly traveled along the meridians. It was stronger than the previous warm air after completing the task. The whole body was warm. The fatigue was instantly dissipated, and the soul power in the body was instantly filled.

"Hey, is there a reward for this? And it came so quickly?" Wu Jiang was delighted.

When Judge Wu and others disappeared completely, Wu Jiang did not rush to find the magic weapon in the villa. Instead, he took out his mobile phone and called Boss Wang to tell them that the female ghost had been subdued and that they could come back.

Not long after, Boss Wang, his wife and the old man hurried back. Seeing Wu Jiang standing well in the yard, and Wang Xun who was still sleeping next to him, they quickly gathered around.

"Xiao Jiang, how are you? The female ghost... has the female ghost really been subdued?" Boss Wang asked eagerly, his eyes full of anticipation and anxiety, and he couldn't believe that it all ended so soon.

Wu Jiang smiled and nodded, and said in a relaxed tone: "Uncle Wang, don't worry, the evil ghost has been eliminated and the matter has been completely resolved."

Boss Wang was overjoyed and stepped forward to hold Wu Jiang's hand tightly. Mrs. Wang even cried with joy.

"Let someone carry Wang Xun upstairs first." Wu Jiang said.

Looking at Wang Xun who was still sleeping, everyone looked at Wu Jiang with doubts.

"Don't worry, just wait for the prince to wake up and get some more sunshine, and then prescribe some tonics and you'll be fine!"

Mrs. Wang nodded quickly and thanked Wu Jiang repeatedly: "Thank you, Xiao Jiang, thank you, Xiao Jiang!"

Seeing this, the servants on the side quickly stepped forward and carefully carried Wang Xun to the room on the second floor to rest. Mrs. Wang followed closely behind, guarding her son every step of the way.
